issue_context.title: Integration ASUSWRT fails to start
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After HA OS - ASUSWRT integration fails to start.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.6.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.5.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

ASUSWRT

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/asuswrt

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Log Details (ERROR)
Logger: homeassistant.config_entries
Source: components/asuswrt/router.py:426
First occurred: 12:34:04 (4 occurrences)
Last logged: 15:46:07

Error setting up entry 192.168.1.2 for asuswrt
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/config_entries.py", line 293, in async_setup
    result = await component.async_setup_entry(hass, self)  # type: ignore
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/asuswrt/__init__.py", line 123, in async_setup_entry
    await router.setup()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/asuswrt/router.py", line 230, in setup
    model = await _get_nvram_info(self._api, "MODEL")
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/asuswrt/router.py", line 426, in _get_nvram_info
    info = await api.async_get_nvram(info_type)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/aioasuswrt/asuswrt.py", line 275, in async_get_nvram
    lines = await self.connection.async_run_command(_NVRAM_CMD)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/aioasuswrt/connection.py", line 140, in async_run_command
    return [line.decode("utf-8") for line in data]
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/aioasuswrt/connection.py", line 140, in <listcomp>
    return [line.decode("utf-8") for line in data]
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xb0 in position 19: invalid start byte
```


### Additional information

Integration deleted/installed, Core restarted - same.
comments:
Hey there @kennedyshead, @ollo69, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`asuswrt`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L50) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
Will propose a PR to fix this issue

review_comments: Longer term it would be better if the library caught these errors and raised documented library specific errors instead. How should the library user know to catch `UnicodeDecodeError`?
[PR #78](https://github.com/kennedyshead/aioasuswrt/pull/78) is already merged in `aioasuswrt` library. When new library version will be available I will rollback this change.
